notes.title: Optimized the game's level refresh logic, reducing some level repetition
notes.content:
Improved the game's level refresh logic

New random levels will now refresh after 7 levels

The level rhythm was changed from the original group of 4 to the group of 3

Start time changed from 75 to 65

notes.title: A known serious BUG in the game
notes.content:
[b]One of the more serious bugs in the game is known:[/b]

This BUG can be avoided manually:

Trigger mode: [strike][u]Reset position appears after hitting the wall when selecting the UI interface, press the mouse key, key input will fail ！！！！[/u][/strike]

[b][u]Temporary Solution Go to the UI interface of reset location selection, do not press the mouse!!![/u][/b]
